sentences.text: Cr.MP(M) No. 250 of 2024 16.02.2024 Present: Mr. Nand Lal Thakur, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Vishal Panwar, Additional Advocate General for the respondent-State.
Mr. Vishal Panwar, learned Additional r Advocate General appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the respondent.
Let status report be filed within ten days.

2. The bail petitioner Dheeraj Kumar has come up before this Court seeking bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with the F.I.R. No. 224 of 2023 dated 04.07.2023 under Section 406, 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B of the Indian Penal Code registered at Police Station Una.

3. Notably, the bail petitioner has approached this Court in Cr.MP(M) No. 1987 of 2023 for pre-arrest bail, which was disallowed, by the co-ordinate Bench, of this Court on 22.09.2023 (Annexure P-7).
4.

The bail petitioner has again approached this Court by filing Cr.MP(M) No. 2893 of 2023 which was dismissed as withdrawn by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 19.12.2023 (Annexure P-8),
due to non-presence of the bail petitioner.
5.

Now, by way of the instant bail application, the petitioner has again come up before this Court, .
seeking pre-arrest bail on the ground that the co- accused (Rakhi Kumari) had filed an application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure vide Cr.M.P(M) No. 3013 of 2023 which was granted by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 05.01.2024 (Annexure P-4).
6.
At this stage, Mr. Nand Lal Thakur, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has been falsely implicated.

Be that as it may, without going into this aspect at this stage, keeping in view the fact that once the petitioner had approached this Court for anticipatory bail vide Cr.M.P(M)
No. 2893 of 2023, which was dismissed as withdrawn on 19.12.2023 (Annexure P-8) then, despite the dismissal of the earlier bail request, the State Authorities have not resorted to any action against the petitioner since 19.12.2023 till day the State Authorities had anything substantial against the bail petitioner.

7. In the entirety of facts and circumstances, referred to above, this Court is inclined to grant an interim bail to the petitioner till the next date of hearing, with the following conditions:-
(i) In the event of the arrest of the petitioner, he shall be released on .
